architecture_summary: LangChain provides a modular framework for building LLM applications with chainable components. It supports RAG through document loaders, text splitters, vector stores, retrievers, and LLM integration. The ecosystem includes LangGraph for agent orchestration and LangSmith for observability.
key_modules: langchain-core: Base abstractions and interfaces; langchain-community: Third-party integrations; langchain: Chains, agents, and retrieval strategies; langgraph: Agent orchestration and workflow management
installation_summary: Available via pip/uv: 'uv add langchain'. Supports multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and vector stores (Chroma, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.).
reproducibility_notes: Well-documented API with extensive examples and cookbooks
limitations: Abstraction overhead may introduce complexity for simple use cases
